content: Lease/visibility-timeout is the canonical crash-safe work-claim pattern: a worker atomically claims a row, holds a time-bound lease, renews it via heartbeat while working, and on crash the lease expires so another worker can reclaim. Add a monotonically increasing fencing token per claim so a resurrected zombie worker's writes are rejected. Postgres SKIP LOCKED (pg-boss, graphile-worker) is the standard SQL implementation; SQLite needs an explicit UPDATE...WHERE lease_expires_at < now() claim. Key hazard: handler outliving the lease causes double-execution, so renewal cadence must be well under lease TTL and side effects must be idempotent.
